title: AI Software Engineer
summary: AI Software Engineer and Tech Lead with **9+ years** of experience. Expert in building web architectures, developing **multi-agent systems**, and leading **DevOps** operations, from CI/CD automation to cloud infrastructure management.

bullets: Accelerated coding and technical problem-solving by integrating **AI assistants** (Claude Code CLI, Google Antigravity) directly into the development workflow.
Built and maintained the **backend architecture** for core infrastructure and the Moodle ecosystem using PHP, Python, and JavaScript, optimizing system performance and **scalability** in production.
Developed multi-agent systems and carried out the **full migration** of AI infrastructure from Google Cloud Platform to **AWS Bedrock**.
**Reduced API consumption costs** and foundation-model latency by limiting context windows, profiling the right model for each task, and refining prompt engineering.

Automated production releases through **CI/CD pipelines** and managed cloud infrastructure (AWS, Linux), establishing a **DevOps culture** and stricter development practices to prevent system outages.
Led the company's **technology strategy**, defining the core architecture, evaluating third-party integrations, and driving the adoption of new technologies across multiple concurrent projects.

Standardized the team's engineering practices by instituting **code reviews**, static analysis tooling (ESLint), and agile planning methodologies, which sped up onboarding of new developers and improved **software quality**.

Implemented DevOps practices by managing production infrastructure (Linux servers, firewalls, Datadog) and systematized deployments through CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), **eliminating hours of manual work** and drastically reducing release errors.
Built and maintained end-to-end web platforms, developing **robust back ends** with Laravel (PHP) and relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), and interactive front ends with JavaScript and Vue.js.
**Optimized overall performance** of production applications by refactoring database queries and designing responsive interfaces focused on improving the end-user experience.
Translated business requirements into clear technical specifications, taking part in the **full development lifecycle** to reduce rework and ensure on-time delivery.
Built and maintain an **ecosystem of open-source tools** (including TaskFlow and Vue/Laravel utilities) focused on improving developer experience (DX).
Manage the project lifecycle on GitHub, defining the technical roadmap, reviewing pull requests (PRs), and **actively resolving issues** reported by the community.

Facilitated adoption of these tools by writing **clear technical documentation** and designing direct integrations that save other engineers hours of setup, motivated by a commitment to free and collaborative software.
